# Mindelo

> Mindelo is a custom software studio in Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago. It finds the work a business still does by hand, then automates it or connects it to the software the business already uses, and stays on to keep it running.

Mindelo was founded by Zane Adams and Michael Taylor Walker. It builds for how Caribbean businesses operate, including WhatsApp Business, WiPay, and Trinidad and Tobago phone formats. Clients start with a free 30-minute consult, and most continue on a monthly partnership.

## Services

- [Services](https://mindelo.site/services): business dashboards, custom operations software, job and production tracking, quoting and follow-up systems, systems integration, document data capture, websites, bookings and inboxes, customer portals, and automated reporting.
- [Voice receptionist](https://mindelo.site/voice-receptionist): a phone receptionist that answers calls, books appointments, and answers customer questions.

## Work

- [Portfolio](https://mindelo.site/portfolio): selected projects for Trinidad and Tobago businesses.
- [Websites](https://mindelo.site/portfolio/websites): live websites Mindelo built for Trinidad and Tobago businesses.
- [Demos](https://mindelo.site/demo): interactive demos of Mindelo systems.
